item.title: Austin County Adds Explosives K-9 Expertise Ahead of Major Events [VIDEO]
item.description: Austin County enhances public safety by adding explosives K-9 expertise to the Sheriff's Office, funded through Senate Bill 22, for better protection at large events and festivals.

item.title: Colony Ridge Settles for $68 Million: Texas and Feds End Predatory Lending Lawsuit with Major Reforms
item.description: The Colony Ridge Texas settlement of $68 million resolves federal and state claims of deceptive practices targeting Hispanic buyers, mandating major infrastructure fixes and sales reforms in Liberty County.

item.title: From Smartphones to AI: Senate Hearing Focuses on Growing Risks for America’s Youth [VIDEO]
item.description: The Senate social media kids hearing exposed alarming trends in youth screen time and mental health, with experts urging action on bills to curb tech's harmful effects on children.

item.title: Ring Ends Planned Flock Safety Integration After Super Bowl Ad Sparks Surveillance Fears
item.description: Amazon’s Ring cancels its planned integration with Flock Safety after public backlash over privacy concerns tied to AI-powered neighborhood surveillance.

item.title: West End Library Sponsors Texas America250 Challenge for 2026
item.description: The Austin County West End Library is sponsoring the Texas America250 Challenge, encouraging residents to log 2,500 minutes of reading, park visits, or volunteer service in 2026 to celebrate America’s 250th anniversary.
